718 S 4TH ST - CHICKASHA, OKLAHOMA 73018

(405) 825-3424

Welcome to Star Buds dispensary in Chickasha! We are your top rated medical dispensary source for all your medical marijuana needs. We are conveniently located on the corner of 4th St and W Oregon Ave in Chickasha. Our Dispensaries offer medical customers an industry leading selection of premium quality cannabis products. We maintain a large selection of flower, extracts, concentrates, tinctures, topicals and edibles. We have curated a selection of products and brands from the top growers and manufacturers in the nation. Our dispensary seeks to always have something in store for everyone whether you are new to cannabis or a long time user.

Here at Star Buds customer satisfaction has always been a top priority in our stores. Our hope is to create a memorable cannabis dispensary experience for every customer. It is our goal to provide our customers with the knowledge and insight necessary to make sure you are getting the products best suited for your needs. Stop in today and let one of our knowledgeable and experienced staff members guide you through the dispensary process.

Looking for extra speed and convenience? Skip the line and place your order online to pick up in store! Looking to save money on your next visit to one of our dispensaries? take advantage of all of the current ways to save by checking out our deals page that gets updated regularly!

Star Buds Chickasha Medical Weed Dispensary is proud to serve cannabis consumers in Grady County to include the communities of Alex, Amber, Anadarko, Apache, Binger, Blanchard, Bradley, Cement, Chickasha, Cyril, Dibble, Elgin, Fletcher, Gracemont, Lindsay, Minco, Mustang, Newcastle, Ninnekah, Oklahoma City, Pocasset, Rush Springs, Sterling, Tuttle, Union City, Verden, Wheatland and the surrounding areas.

Are you wondering where to find the best dispensary with high-quality medical marijuana near you? Welcome to Star Buds Medical Weed Dispensary Chickasha, the best medical marijuana store in Grady County! Our storefront is at 718 S 4th St, Chickasha, OK 73018, near the Chickasha Area YMCA and just north of Chickasha Sports Complex.

​

Upon arriving at Star Buds Chickasha, you will immediately experience what sets us apart from other dispensaries. Whether you are new to medical marijuana or have been to a dispensary near you before, we provide you with outstanding customer service to help you find high-quality products at a reasonable price. Our dispensary is home to an assortment of top-quality cannabis strains and weed products, including pre-rolls, carts/cartridges, edibles, concentrates, topicals, cannabis flowers, vapes, and CBD products.

Star Buds Chickasha Medical Weed Dispensary also offers the convenience of online ordering and in-store pick up any time during our business hours! Don’t forget about our incredible deals and rewards program! We offer an outstanding rewards program and daily specials to help you save on all of your favorite cannabis products.

Star Buds Dispensaries was created in 2013 with a goal in mind to change the way people think about cannabis. Our store is open 7 days a week 8:00am to 12:00 am 365 days a year to add to your convenience. Stop in today at one of our 7 Oklahoma locations and experience the difference with Star Buds dispensaries!

Know Before You Go…

This is my first time visiting Star Buds. What should I bring with me?

All visitors must be at least 18 years of age with a valid medical card and must provide a valid photo ID. We take cash and debit cards and there is also an ATM inside our dispensary for your convenience.

​

Is your dispensary open late?

We understand that normal operating hours are not always convenient for our consumers with busy lifestyles, which is why our dispensary is open Monday through Sunday from 8:00 am to 12:00 am

Does Star Buds offer any discounts or ways to save on orders?

We run product specials seven days a week, and our loyalty rewards program offers even more savings. We are happy to provide our MED card holders and veterans with a discount upon request.
